name: code-retrainer
description: Code Fluency Training Platform — a language-agnostic deliberate-practice environment for building independent coding fluency.

scripts.verify: npm run generate:check && npm run copyright:check && npm run spelling:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run web && npm run test
scripts.bundle: node packages/cli/dist/main.js content bundle --language python,javascript,typescript,react,angular,node && node packages/cli/dist/main.js content activities && npm run bundle:desktop
scripts.web: npm run build && npm run vendor && npm run bundle && npm run build --workspace @code-retrainer/web
scripts.web:dev: npm run bundle && npm run dev --workspace @code-retrainer/web
scripts.e2e: npm run web && npm run e2e --workspace @code-retrainer/web
scripts.screenshots: npm run web && playwright test screenshots --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts
